title: infra-aws: idleClientTimeout set on the billing DBProxy
author: CI pipeline (infrastructure team)
summary: Applied the infra-aws repository. Added the idleClientTimeout field to the DBProxy resource billing-db-proxy (namespace ack-system). The field was not set, so the proxy fell back to the AWS default of 1800 s. Goal stated in the merge request: purge idle client connections earlier, as the RDS Proxy documentation explicitly allows.
review: Two approvals from the infrastructure team. No value was overwritten and the resource carried no comment: there was nothing to contradict.
tags: infrastructure aws rds dbproxy idleclienttimeout ack billing

title: infra-aws: idle timeout raised on the billing-api load balancer
author: CI pipeline (infrastructure team)
summary: Idle timeout of the billing-api load balancer raised from 60 s to 120 s so that long invoice exports are no longer cut. The billing-api HTTP keep-alive idle timeout was raised in the same change to stay above the load balancer idle timeout, as required.
diff: ALB billing-api-alb: idle timeout 60 -> 120; billing-api: HTTP keep-alive idle timeout 65 -> 125
review: One approval from the infrastructure team, one from the billing team.
tags: infrastructure aws alb load balancer idle timeout keep-alive billing-api export
